Celebrating the Global Simultaneous Release, BCG Fest feat. ONE PIECE CARD GAME is here!
Make the most of this special weekend and dive into the game.
Don’t miss special events, exclusive products, and exciting activities!
Kay Bailey Hutchison Convention Center Dallas Hall B/C
650 S Griffin St, Dallas, TX 75202 USA
*There will be no onsite badges, no General Entry.
Enjoy special events like the Flame-Flame Fruit Coliseum and CS26–27 Season 1 Finals, plus a wide range of side events.
Joining this event will require application in advance.
Please refer to official event communications for the most up-to-date dates, times, and event information.
Partner hotels in the area offer a special rate for BCG Fest feat. ONE PIECE CARD GAME attendees.
Special products to commemorate “Flame-Flame Fruit Coliseum” will be available for purchase.
Premium Card Collection - Flame-Flame Fruit Coliseum Edition
Official Playmat - Flame-Flame Fruit Coliseum Edition
Limited Card Sleeve - Flame-Flame Fruit Coliseum Edition
Limited Card Sleeve Standard Orange Silver
Official Storage Box - Flame-Flame Fruit Coliseum Edition
There will be an livestream on YouTube!
Pick up your Stamp Card when you receive your event badge and collect stamps at all 4 activity spots!
Experience your favorite characters on giant-sized cards!
Preserve your memories from the event with a special photo opportunity!
